collect.//server: scripts/lighthouse-server.mjs, not `pnpm start`: it is `next start` (no -H, see the script) with BACKEND_URL pointing at the stub backend the public-page smoke asserts on (scripts/public-job-stub.mjs). The two public pages below read the API on every request and need it; the other URLs never did. It prints the ready line only once both public pages have answered 200 from this stub. startServerReadyTimeout is its cap, not a wait: lhci proceeds on the first match.
collect.//urls: b6/m6 (#755): root + public marketing-inner (matchning, cv-granskning, hjalpcenter, for-utvecklare) + guest mirrors (gast/jobb, gast/oversikt, gast/cv). These are backend-free (guest mirrors are mock-data, marketing-inner is static content), and the landing's stats read gets the stub's 401 and renders without stats, as it did with no BACKEND_URL at all. The guest mirrors exercise the same layout/bundle surfaces as the authed pages (i18n payload, wizard/CSS bundles) where the audit's bundle findings concentrate. S6 (#2090, CTO B10) adds the two public pages that read the API per request, /jobb/<uuid> and /lediga-jobb, served from the stub: the uuid is the stub's listed ad, so keep the two in step. They measure the page around a short stub ad and 20 stub rows, not a long real ad's text. Authed pages are a follow-up gated on TD-89's seeded CI stack (LHCI puppeteerScript form-login with the dev-test account, NOT committed here). numberOfRuns(3) runs per URL, so the collect phase scales ~linearly with the number of URLs (`jq '.ci.collect.url | length' lighthouserc.json`); the job stays observe-only (continue-on-error, not in ci.needs) so this never extends the blocking critical path.
collect.//extraHeaders: #1052: the three /gast/* mirrors were not measuring the guest pages — they were measuring the welcome modal. `GuestWelcomeModal` is mounted from (guest)/gast/layout.tsx with `showWelcome={!welcomed}`, gated on the `__Host-jobbliggaren_guest_welcomed` cookie; Lighthouse runs a clean profile every time, so the modal opened on every run. Radix portals dialog content client-side, so its <DialogDescription> became the largest contentful element AND could not exist until React had hydrated — measured 3212/3218/3240 ms against 2277-2989 ms for the five URLs whose LCP element is server-rendered text (CI artifact, run 30167162198). This header sets the cookie so the collect phase measures the pages, which is what the //urls note above says these mirrors are here for: to exercise the same layout/bundle surfaces as the authed pages — and no authed page has a first-visit overlay. It is set for every URL because lhci applies collect.settings globally; the URLs other than the three /gast/* mirrors never read the cookie (the public job page's twin is chosen on the SESSION cookie, so this one leaves /jobb/<uuid> on its public page). WHAT THIS IS NOT: it is not a fix and nothing got faster. A real first-time guest still sees the modal and still has that LCP; Klas decided 2026-07-25 that the welcome stays a modal. The expected outcome here is the 2,8-3,0 s band, NOT green — if a /gast/* URL comes back under 2500 ms, re-run before believing it (§F: the instrument swings >=350 ms at the threshold).

assert.//inp: INP är field-metrik; lab approximerar via TBT. ADR 0045: observe-only (warn).
assert.//score: Composite perf-score: observe-only (loggas, ej assert) — ADR 0045 Beslut 2.
assert.//pageweight: Page-weight-budget — ADR 0045 Beslut 2 (gate-intent/error), tidigare budget.json (retirerad, se //fix-2026-07-20). resourceType-namnen (document/script/stylesheet/image/font/total/third-party) är Lighthouse core's egna resource-summary-kategorier (core/computed/resource-summary.js) — inte uppfunna. aggregationMethod:median satt EXPLICIT (lhci:s default för resource-summary-assertions är annars 'optimistic' = bästa-av-3, vilket bryter mot projektets uttalade median-disciplin ovan för samma numberOfRuns:3-körning).
assert.//pageweight-note: Civic-utility-sida utan tunga assets (DESIGN.md). Budgetar satta stramt — Jobbliggaren ska vara lätt. Kalibrerade mot uppmätt baslinje vid första gröna Lighthouse-runs (CTO: kalibrera mot fakta, ej gissning).
assert.//includePassedAssertions: Without it lhci 0.15.1 writes only failing rows to .lighthouseci/assertion-results.json, and the job summary (.github/scripts/lighthouse-summary.sh) renders that file.
